headline: Overnight in Ethiopia: EHRC confirms 48 killed in Shirka Woreda Oct 24 attack (23 local security, 5 militia, 13 civilians + 7 civilians by informal armed individuals); attackers identified as OLA/'Shane' per EHRC; 20 injured, 21 homes burned, 247 families displaced; Oromia gov says 73 detained; EHRC calls for independent investigation

Amhara (Hayiq Jari 2 IDP camp) aftermath: residents now say Oct 29 drone strike killed 18, injured 22 (incl. 3 pregnant women, 8-yr-old girl); struck 5+ times; 1,800+ IDPs mostly from East/Kellem Wollega; support centres, classrooms, markets closed; unorganised departures to host communities; perpetrator not stated, unverified

Families flee again in NW Tigray: UN says recent returnees to Tahtay Adiyabo forced to flee again; 62,707 people (12,155 hh) had returned to six Tigray woredas (Oct 2025); thousands displaced in Shire and Debre Birhan; insecurity restricts Gonder-Debark/Metema roads; no UN breakdown; UN scaling up aid

EHRC confirms 48 killed in Shirka Woreda Oct 24 attack (Amharic): 23 local security, 5 militia, 13 civilians + 7 civilians by informal armed individuals; attackers identified as OLA per EHRC; 20 injured, 21 homes burned, 247 families displaced; Oromia says 73 detained (unverified); EHRC calls for independent investigation

Regional response: Ethiopia orders 6 Sudanese diplomatic staff to leave Sudan's Assosa consulate (Benishangul-Gumuz) within 48 hours (senior Ethiopian official to Reuters, Nov 4); no reason given; follows Sudan's UNSC/AU PSC complaints over drones; mutual accusations (RSF / Tigrayan forces) denied; Sudan adviser Amjad Farid: Khartoum trying to avoid open war

Overnight in Ethiopia: Konso Zone (Arba Klala, Kolme Woreda): 4 farmers killed, 1 abducted by armed group of up to 20 (Borkena citing police; residents say from Alle Zone; similar attack a month earlier killed 9); Moyale: clashes in 7 districts since Oct 18, intensified at night, two mediation attempts failed, Borana and Somali elders refuse to yield land (Addis Standard, unverified)
source: Borkena, Nov 4 2026; Addis Standard via allAfrica, Nov 4 2026

headline: Nationwide rights: 2026 Ibrahim Index ranks Ethiopia 30th/54, trajectory 'Warning Signs'; Rights -10.4 (45th), Media Freedom -13 (50th of 54), Protection against Discrimination -22.2, Absence of Armed Conflict -31.7, Security & Safety -11.8; gains in accountability, gender, infrastructure, regional integration; warns Red Sea port push could reignite conflict with Eritrea

Moyale refugees in Kenya update: registration began ~Oct 31 at Harhosa and OMC camps, Marsabit (Kenyan authorities, UNHCR, Kenya Red Cross); blue ID wristbands incl. children, household profiling and assistance cards to follow; 50,000+ reportedly crossed; sheltering in schools/churches (St. Mary's, Manyatta Burji, Sessi); $8.9M 3-month appeal

Sudan closes Ethiopian consulate in Gedaref, expels diplomats (Amharic): two Sudanese officials to Reuters; retaliation for Ethiopia's closure of Sudan's Assosa consulate (6 diplomats, 48 hours, no reason given); Sudan UNSC/AU PSC complaints over RSF drones from Ethiopian territory, denied; Ethiopia accuses Sudan/Egypt/Eritrea of backing Tigrayan forces, denied; adviser Amjad Farid: avoiding open war; Sudan war 14M+ displaced (UN)

International response (press freedom): HRW (Nov 3) calls The Reporter's indefinite suspension part of 'ongoing assault on the media and civic space'; last privately owned Amharic newspaper; journalists Samuel Getachew and Amanuel Gebremedhin jailed 8 days in October; HRW urges reversal and international partners to press for it

Overnight in Ethiopia (Moyale follow-up, Kenya side): Kenya IG Douglas Kanja orders more police to Moyale during Nov 5 visit; Kenya Red Cross says affected population rose from ~36,000 to 50,000+ (displaced Ethiopians + hosts); stray bullets forced some Kenyan families from homes; power shortages as Moyale relies on Ethiopian electricity
source: Kenya News Agency via KBC, Nov 6 2026; Nairobi News, Nov 6 2026

headline: East Arsi, Oromia (Robe Woreda, Endato kebele): at least 34 Orthodox Christian residents reported killed in Nov 5 attack by unnamed armed men from ~11am (Mahibere Kidusan TV via Meseret Media/Borkena, unverified); security personnel also targeted; shops/homes burned; blocked roads kept wounded from care; follows Oct 24 Shirka attack (EHRC: 48 killed)

Explainer: Eastern Route migration from Ethiopia (IOM): 20,000+ journeys Ethiopia->Djibouti since Sept 10; 3,000+ stranded in Djibouti Sept 20-30, reports of desert deaths near Ethiopian border; 70,200 Yemen arrivals Jan-Apr 2026 (+9%); Oct 9 Obock shipwreck 139 dead, 84 missing of 305

East Arsi, Robe Woreda: at least 34 Orthodox Christian civilians reported killed (Amharic; repeat of 10am English story): bodies gathered at Endato Debre Mitmaq St. Mary Church (Mahibere Kidusan TV via Borkena, unverified); security personnel targeted; shops/homes burned; blocked roads kept wounded from care; follows Oct 24 Shirka attack (EHRC: 48 killed)

International response explainer: UN SG Guterres (Oct 31) urges parties in northern Ethiopia to spare civilians/critical infrastructure and 'agree without delay to a cessation of hostilities', engage in good faith with mediation; context: Tedros Nov 2 health warning, Guterres Oct 10 call, AU chair Youssouf Sept 23 restraint/Pretoria talks call
source: UN News, Nov 2 2026 (UN SG statement Oct 31); Xinhua, Sept 24 2026

headline: Overnight in Ethiopia: ENDF imposes night vehicle ban (8PM-6AM) in Mekelle from Friday; house-to-house inspections 6AM-6PM; 3 days to surrender unregistered firearms to Tigray Region Police Commission; military cites crime/detainee releases, TPLF spokesperson Michael Asgedom rejects (Borkena, unverified)

South Ethiopia (Burji & Koore zones): police officials report repeated cross-border attacks from West Guji (Oromia) - civilian deaths, livestock looting, displacement (no figures); Burji pursues Geda elder mediation; both zones seek federal troops (Borkena, officials' claims, unverified)

Explainer: Ethiopia's displaced in numbers (UNHCR data sheet as of Aug 31 2026): 1,919,993 IDPs; 82% conflict, 9% social tension, 4% drought; Tigray 761,284, Oromia 749,534, Amhara 166,353, Afar 123,767; 1,023,565 refugees/asylum seekers (53% children); predates Oct displacement

Benishangul-Gumuz (Assosa Zone, Buldiglu district, Daleti kebele): over 52 killed in Thursday dawn attack, 21 civilians, rest regional anti-riot/militia (Amharic); police commissioner Endris Mohammed links to OLA, OLA no comment; residents briefly displaced, returned; unverified

Accountability/international response: HRW's Laetitia Bader to European Parliament DROI subcommittee - international scrutiny of Ethiopia 'largely inexistent'; abuses attributed to Tigrayan authorities (forced recruitment, boys as young as 15), Amhara forces (W. Tigray), apparent govt drone strikes (Aug 20, 13 injured); urges EU to press all parties on IHL, comms, aid/monitor access, transitional justice

Overnight in Ethiopia: ENDF troops and equipment seen moving from Adwa toward Rama (Central Tigray) Nov 5-6; TDF reported in/around town; Rama ~7 km from Mereb River, changed hands since Oct 14; Oct 30 drone strike on civilian truck killed 12 (ACLED)

Oromia-Somali border (Moyale/Dawa, Ethiopian side) update: clashes since Oct 18 spread to 7 districts, heaviest in Areero/Dawa basin; two mediation attempts failed (Southern Oromia security official); elders give opposing accounts; Gadaa journey route blocked; federal govt silent; unverified

Moyale displacement aid update: UN ERC Tom Fletcher allocates $3M CERF (Nov 6) for northern Kenya; ~50,000 fled southern Ethiopia into Kenya (Moyale Sub-County, Marsabit; mostly women & children, host communities); UNHCR/UNICEF/IOM/WFP $8.9M appeal (Nov 5, 3 months); OCHA: Ethiopian side volatile, homes destroyed; UK travel warning added Moyale

Moyale displacement aid (Amharic; repeat of 1pm English story): UN ERC Tom Fletcher $3M CERF (Nov 6) for northern Kenya; ~50,000 fled southern Ethiopia into Kenya (Moyale Sub-County, Marsabit; mostly women & children); UNHCR/UNICEF/IOM/WFP $8.9M appeal (Nov 5); OCHA: Ethiopian side volatile, homes destroyed

Weekly roundup 'This week across Ethiopia' Nov 2-8: WHO Tedros warns northern health system near collapse; EHRC confirms 48 killed in Shirka (Arsi); The Reporter suspended indefinitely; ~50,000 fled Moyale into Kenya, UN $3M CERF
source: UN News Nov 2; Addis Standard via allAfrica Nov 4; Africanews/AFP Nov 3; Kenyans.co.ke (UN/OCHA) Nov 7 2026

headline: Overnight in Ethiopia: Wuchale (Ambasel, South Wollo) - residents say fighter jets and drones used Nov 3 as federal forces fought Fano; homes/businesses reportedly set on fire; govt forces regained town that afternoon; clashes continued in Robit, Wurgessa, Girana; transport disrupted; unverified. Tigray: clashes in Adet, Bizet, May-Kinetal, Shiraro, Egela; TPF and TPLF both claim Bizet

Tigray (Chila town, Abergele district, Central Tigray): UXO from former military camp, collected as scrap, killed 10 incl. 4 children Oct 28 (humanitarian workers/residents); drought driving scrap collection; UNMAS and others halted demining/risk education after Sept fighting; unverified

Moyale displaced follow-up (conditions/aid): Kenya Red Cross says displaced rose from ~36,000 to 50,000+ (unconfirmed); 6 sites hosting Ethiopians in Kenya; no contingency food stocks, no camp until security improves (Kenya acting refugee commissioner); diarrhoea spreading, malaria fears; Ethiopian Red Cross 30M birr aid to 1,000 households in Moyale; trucks stranded ~2 weeks, ~20% price rises

Tigray (Chila town, Abergele district, Central Tigray) UXO kills 10 incl. 4 children Oct 28 (Amharic; repeat of 10am English story): ordnance from former military camp collected as scrap; drought driving scrap collection; UNMAS demining/risk education halted after September fighting; unverified

International response: AU (Commissioner Bankole Adeoye) steps up Ethiopia-Eritrea diplomacy, urges implementation of Algiers and Pretoria agreements; Uhuru Kenyatta shuttle diplomacy; AU 'does not take sides'; warns outside interference prolongs crises

Overnight in Ethiopia: Kenya's Mudavadi calls Ethiopian FM Gedion Timotheos over Moyale clashes, urges de-escalation so ~40,000 evacuated to Kenya can return; Ethiopia assured it would restore normalcy (per Mudavadi); Wazema: Oromia-Somali clashes continued, residents say federal forces not deployed as of Monday (unverified); stray bullets/UXO on Kenyan side; Kenya extra police Nov 5
source: The Star (Kenya), Nov 9 2026; Wazema Radio, Nov 10 2026

headline: Benishangul-Gumuz (Dalati, Buldiglu Woreda, Assosa Zone) update: residents say Nov 5-6 attacks killed 65+ incl. at least 27 civilians, ~45 security forces; police commissioner Mohammed Idriss (BBC Amharic): 52 incl. 21 civilians, blames 'OLF-Shene'; attackers unidentified; ~2 days with no federal intervention (witness); 100+ reports unverified

Tigray health system strain (NPR): Mekelle surgeon says ER flooded 7-8 days after late-Sept fighting, no network/electricity; doctors unpaid for months after federal funding cut; Tigray health worker counts 100+ maternal deaths past year (unverified); PHR/OJAH survey of 600+ health workers 2020-2024: 63% ambulance attacks, 57% armed takeovers, by both sides

Tigray health system strain (Amharic; repeat of 1pm English story, NPR): Mekelle ER flooded 7-8 days after late-Sept fighting; doctors unpaid for months after federal funding cut; 100+ maternal deaths past year per Tigray health worker (unverified); PHR/OJAH survey 600+ health workers 2020-2024: 63% ambulance attacks, 57% armed takeovers, by both sides. NOTE: description quoted the article title incorrectly (real title: 'A healthcare system unravels as conflict mounts')

International response: China sends envoys to Horn of Africa (FM Mao Ning, Nov 2); Hu Changchun met Eritrea's Isaias in Asmara Nov 5 (Eritrean MoI: China respects Eritrea's sovereignty/territorial integrity; no agreements listed; no Chinese readout as of Nov 9); Liu Xianfa due in Ethiopia, Djibouti, Egypt early-mid Nov; CTP (citing Ethiopian MFA) says Liu met FM Gedion Nov 4 (unconfirmed)
source: Rio Times, Nov 9 2026; Prensa Latina, Nov 2 2026; Critical Threats, Nov 6 2026

headline: Overnight in Ethiopia: Badme - residents tell Wazema ENDF and TPLF forces clashed last week, Eritrean troops reportedly involved; Eritrean forces had withdrawn, town under neither side's effective control; Monday clashes in Rama/Gemahalo with reported joint force (make-up unverified); Tigray caretaker admin to start salary arrears Nov 11, ~140,000 public employees (Getachew Reda), only staff who reported to work

Western Oromia (Tulu Wayu town, Abe Dongoro district, Western Oromia zone, formerly Horo Guduru Wollega): eight members of one family killed in their home Tuesday (Nov 3); attackers returned Wednesday, burned homes, residents fled; local sources name armed men operating as 'Fano' (Wazema could not verify identity/affiliation)

Arsi (Merti woreda) displacement: community reps say 21 of 23 kebeles fully displaced (unverified); some displaced up to 3 years, others since late-Oct attacks; flight across Merti, Shirka, Aseko, Robe; armed groups not named; shortages of food/clothing/care; administrator says aid 'severely insufficient'

Badme fighting (Amharic; repeat of 7am English story, Wazema): residents say ENDF and TPLF forces clashed in Badme last week, Eritrean troops reportedly involved; Eritrean forces had withdrawn, neither side in effective control; Monday clashes in Rama/Gemahalo with reported 'joint force' (unverified); Badme background (1998-2000 war, boundary ruling, 2018 acceptance)

International response: G7 foreign ministers (Paris, Nov 9-10; declaration published Nov 11) voice great concern over worsening Ethiopia-Eritrea security situation and risk of regional escalation; urge maximum restraint, diplomatic solutions, safe unhindered humanitarian access, protection of civilians; back UN and AU de-escalation efforts
source: G7 Foreign Ministers' joint declaration (GOV.UK), Nov 11 2026

headline: Overnight in Ethiopia: Borana livestock markets collapse as Moyale fighting spreads into Borana (3rd week); Haroo Bakkee Sunday market ~40 cattle trucks down to 3 or fewer; young bull 120-150k Birr now 70-90k (Yabello resident); Kenyan buyers gone; Borana University economist estimates 90%+ drop, warns of long-term poverty

Somali region explainer (transitional justice): Somali Regional State TRC (est. 2021, operating 2022, 7 commissioners, mandate 1991-2018 abuses) took ~50,000 statements (commissioner Fowsia Abdulkadir); report finished but awaiting regional parliament approval, expected Nov-Dec (Juweria Ali); naming perpetrators most sensitive; not yet published

Moyale displaced follow-up (IOM rapid assessment of 758 households in Moyale, Kenya): ~50,000 crossed since late Oct; 71% not enough to eat, 80% say food most urgent; 44% insufficient drinking water; 3/4+ no handwashing; >half health-care difficulty; 96% fled mainly from Oromia/Somali regions; 9 in 10 say entire village fled; >half children, many under five

Jimma (Oromia) protests (Amharic): Mon-Tue protests in Jimma city, esp. Bore neighbourhood, triggered by killing of a former ENDF member; residents say at least 3 killed by security forces Tuesday and 50+ detained Wednesday (unverified by Addis Standard); residents allege forced conscription of young men, arbitrary taxes, extortion; Oromia officials previously denied forced-conscription allegations, no comment on these events

International response: five US Democratic senators (Shaheen, Booker, Coons, Merkley, Van Hollen) send 2nd letter to Rubio (Nov 10): ceasefire + inclusive mediation, end drones/heavy weapons in civilian areas, humanitarian access/food surge, pause new arms sales, regional restraint ('Ethiopia should not be the arena for a regional proxy war'), Assab off the table, restore TPS for Ethiopians; cites Sept 20 drone strike on CRS aid convoy
source: US Senate Foreign Relations Committee (minority) press release, Nov 11 2026

headline: Overnight in Ethiopia: FEWS NET outlook (Oct 2026-May 2027, pub Nov 10) warns worst drought-hit parts of Tigray, Amhara, Afar could face Emergency (IPC 4) from Feb 2027; fighting intensified late Sept in E/C/NW Tigray and E/N Amhara; ~700,000 got food aid in Sept, 73% drop from Aug (coverage may be higher); East/West Hararghe lowland crop losses >40%
source: FEWS NET via Addis Standard/allAfrica, Nov 12 2026

headline: Central Oromia (Sululta district, near Gorfo, outside Addis Ababa): 50+ truck passengers (Addis Ababa -> Gundo Meskel, Dera) abducted Wednesday ~12:30pm; 2 shot/injured trying to escape; local sources suspect OLA (ransom), OLA denies kidnapping for ransom; no official statement; unverified
